text:
emma: ValleyTrust legal needs a minimal compliance pack before signing the POC agreement. Must-haves: SOC2 control mapping (not the full report), ISO certificate excerpt + scope page, signed penetration test authorization, brief KMS custody statement for the POC, and a simple VPC/network diagram. Also asked whether a 60-day Dedicated POC can be refundable. Need everything before their kickoff call next Thu.

priyanka: Got it. Quick clarifying Q  do they want sample logs or just control->evidence pointers? We usually provide sanitized examples but raw logs need a DPA amendment.

emma: ValleyTrust said "mapping + policy excerpts + signed pen-letter + KMS statement is fine, no raw logs."

oliver: Infra note: Hosted staging uses ephemeral IPs so external scans require Dedicated. If they confirm Dedicated we can assign a /28 and produce a simplified diagram in ~36 hrs. If they stick to hosted we can only do authenticated scans from their vendor via VPN.

kevin: Legal: pen-test letter needs vendor name, scope (IPs/CIDR), allowed ports, and desired window. Typical turnaround is ~48 business hours for a minimal authorization. If they want a same-week signature we need vendor + window today. Draft snippet below: ```
Redwood Inference authorizes [vendor name] to perform coordinated, non-destructive penetration testing against the following targets during [start date]  [end date]: [list IPs/CIDRs]. Tests must be scheduled with Redwood SRE at least 72 hours in advance, must not exfiltrate or modify customer data, and critical findings must be reported immediately to Redwood Security.
```

ana: KMS custody options (short): (1) Redwood-managed keys (keys stored encrypted and non-exportable) for quick POC; (2) customer-managed BYOK (HSM) for Dedicated/private setups. I'll draft a 2-paragraph custody statement highlighting the BYOK migration path.

riley: Pricing: Dedicated normally requires a commit. We can propose: A) Hosted PAYG (no commit), B) 60-day Dedicated trial with refundable deposit (commercial exception), or C) standard 90-day commit. I'll pull numbers and include a prorated refund cutoff (refund before day 30). ETA for quote: today afternoon.

infra-bot: NOTE: NET-7781 created for VPC diagram and CIDR reservation, owner=infra-team.

emma: Action items: Priyanka - SOC2 mapping + ISO excerpt (tom EOD), Ana - KMS custody blurb (tom AM), Kevin - push pen-letter to Legal once vendor+CIDR provided, Oliver/infra - diagram after dedicated confirm (~36 hrs), Riley - pricing options (today). I'll update ValleyTrust with timelines and schedule a check-in Wed. Thanks :thumbsup:
